paraphrase: In this Dhamma and discipline there is gradual training: first restraint by the Pātimokkha, then sense restraint, moderation in eating, wakefulness, mindfulness and clear comprehension, a secluded resting place, abandoning the hindrances, the four jhānas. Some reach nibbāna and some do not; the Tathāgata only points the way, as one who knows the road to Rājagaha.
